build: cargo build --release -p thessa-terrain-native; default release profile and hud feature

ownership.gpl: native Scene::flight_data readout through the shared local_air_kinematics and the old-client AGL ground formula; old-client instruments untouched
ownership.mit: existing render-core frames/instances and render-wgpu terrain/mesh/device/queue unchanged; no game logic moved into MIT crates
ownership.asset: North American X-15 Plane by cmoreau, CC BY 4.0; assets/models/north_american_x-15_plane.LICENSE.txt
ownership.readback_boundary: existing optional final captures and hardware test assertions read back; no runtime per-frame scene readback

data_contract.sampling: shared local_air_kinematics(atmosphere, state, reference body_state, radius) at the completed authority time; surface speed, vertical speed, datum altitude
data_contract.ground: verbatim old-client AGL formula (render-axes origin, spin-undo, same height_m call); a raw-inertial-direction iteration read the wrong terrain by ~140m and is pinned against by regression
data_contract.scope: reference-body readout only; no dominant-body display switching
data_contract.failure_boundary: None without live flight or on failed ephemeris/atmosphere sample; hosts keep the previous readout, telemetry falls back to NaN fields
data_contract.telemetry: spd/vspeed/alt/agl keys appended to the flight status line
data_contract.excluded: dominant-body display, air data beyond shared kinematics, alerts/phases, autopilot blocks

stationary_offscreen.boundary: host presentation/streaming/camera/classify/raster/HUD/upload/GPU-completion latency; excludes setup, pre-stream, warm-up and capture readback
stationary_offscreen.conclusion: overlapping medians on the untouched survey path; no speedup claimed, no adapter tax isolated

live_offscreen.telemetry: throttle=1.000 engine=true control_mode=Navball sas=true rcs=true wheels=true gear=true chutes=false spd=372.2 vspeed=+49.3 alt=942 agl=848
live_offscreen.boundary: full existing local physics demand + per-frame kinematics/height sampling + presentation/streaming/terrain/mesh/HUD/uploads/GPU completion; excludes setup, pre-stream, warm-up and final readback; not isolated sampling cost or game FPS
live_offscreen.comparison_boundary: different camera cover between orbit/chase; not equal-scene runs and not Bevy parity; trajectory (not pixels) is the identity

verification.new_regressions: 500m launch AGL, ~180m/s launch energy, climb under 600 full-thrust steps, None-without-flight, telemetry keys
verification.review: kinematics reuse, verbatim ground formula, reference-body scope, fail-closed sampling, GPL/MIT separation

native_wayland_smoke.telemetry: throttle=1.000 engine=true control_mode=Navball sas=true rcs=true wheels=true gear=true chutes=false spd=367.6 vspeed=+48.6 alt=923 agl=830
native_wayland_smoke.boundary: host presentation requests including compositor policy, not display feedback, GPU-only time or game FPS

legacy_bevy_smoke.environment: THESSA_AUTOBENCH=1 THESSA_AUTOBENCH_VIEW=pilot THESSA_SCREENSHOT_PATH=IMAGE.png THESSA_SCREENSHOT_AT_S=6; not paused
legacy_bevy_smoke.limitations: embedded server executable absent: existing local fallback; old-client instruments untouched; different camera/time/game controls/effects, not audio/network validation or equal-scene parity

captures.meaning: normal terrain-only new-1 HUD regression frame
actual local authority at 10.5s with speed/datum/AGL/vertical readout (372.2m/s, 942m, 848m, +49.3m/s)
legacy unpaused local-fallback pilot, instruments untouched; not equal-scene parity

limitations: Read-only reference-body instruments: no dominant-body display, air-data panel, alerts/phases, autopilot blocks or production navball.
Survey/map camera still legacy; materials remain base-color/Lambert without PBR/shadows/atmosphere parity.
Captures are not visual acceptance or equal-scene Bevy parity.
No device-loss recovery, persistent conforming GPU bisector topology or FastRT acceleration structures are established by this slice.
